title: Before-edit retrieval applies the precision threshold, not only the cap
body:
Source: lane t-vv7e8pj report 2026-11-19: editContext in src/hook/edit-standards.ts caps at 3 via withinBudget but matches by file scope with no retrieval-confidence threshold; ADR 0021 point 10 requires the gate at every moment.
Files: src/hook/edit-standards.ts, test/hook/edit-standards.test.ts
Outcome: the before-edit packet serves only records that pass the same precision gate as task start (scope match plus confidence >= threshold), at most 3.
Proof: `node --test test/hook/edit-standards.test.ts: pass` (5 scope matches, 2 below threshold, serves 3; only low-confidence serves none).
